scope: Normal SDK sound-effect key-on through imported VAB tones: physical voice selection, integer volume/pan, sample/ADSR/pitch register cache, software voice records, dirty/automation/key/reverb masks. Original routines use owned register storage and supplied bank-ready/base/software states. Auto-volume, flushing, SPU synthesis, device cadence and audible playback remain unaccepted.
provided_original_inputs: Original software startup in zero-initialized owned MMIO storage. Bank headers use FakeHead with supplied SPU base and bank-ready state. Each note receives identified software records, dirty/automation/key/reverb masks, mono mode and ADSR offset. No sample transfer, SPU synthesis or device clock.
limits: Normal sound-effect key-on only. Special SDK sample255 is explicit unsupported input and is absent from imported banks.
Software success does not confirm audible playback. Default scene backend still queues requests and returns -1.
Invalid binding, division and pitch lookup inputs are explicit bounded errors, not original invalid-memory/trap acceptance.
Bank-ready state and SPU base are supplied. Original sample DMA, live device behavior and sequence playback are not accepted.
